segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the cleanser removes sebum and blackheads without triggering excess oiliness or breakouts, though one long-time oily-skin user notes any overdrying can make her skin rebound very oily.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: several say it leaves skin soft and hydrated with no stripped feeling, but others report it dries their skin further, causes burning, or is unsuitable for dry skin especially outside humid climates.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report reduced blackheads, whiteheads and clogged pores with no new breakouts, describing the cleanser as effective yet gentle.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most numerous group and mostly describe the cleanser as gentle, non-irritating and fragrance-light, though a minority report burning, redness, blistering-like reactions, or eye stinging.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal/dry skin says her skin feels clean and not stripped, though eye makeup still needs a separate remover.
segments.mature: One reviewer with sensitive, middle-aged skin calls it exceptionally gentle and says harsher products in the line give her zits, raw spots or peeling, but this one does not.

concerns.aging: Only one mature-skin reviewer references age indirectly, praising the formula's gentleness for older, reactive skin; no other aging-specific claims are made.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report the oil leaves skin hydrated and not stripped, sometimes recommending it on especially dry days; several others explicitly report over-drying, tightness, or the need to follow immediately with moisturizer.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers say the cleanser is calm on red or reactive skin with no added redness; conversely, two reviewers describe acute redness, burning, or blistering-like reactions after use.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers credit the cleanser with keeping the moisture barrier intact even with nightly or sole-cleanser use; one reviewer's skin burned and felt moisture-stripped after a single use.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible reduction of blackheads and sebaceous filaments on the nose within one to two weeks; a couple say they noticed no change in blackheads at all.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including acne-prone and cystic-acne sufferers, report no new breakouts and some describe clearing of stubborn or cystic acne over days to months; one reviewer reports an acne flare-up and burning after a single use.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say the cleanser reduces visible sebum and oily residue without leaving greasy film; one oily-skin user cautions that if it over-dries, her skin swings to very oily afterward.
